title: Unresolved-pick resolution research — HLTV first, then first-party esportsbook and market lines
policy: Dated first-party research on every fixture the complete-picks pipeline left unresolved at the 2026-10-16T19:38:00Z production snapshot (8 of 21 active fixtures). Method order follows the published ladder: HLTV identity first, then Polymarket / Kalshi / Thunderpick / Bovada money lines, then the Valve official-ratings model. Every observation below was read from the linked official endpoint during the stated window and carries its own timestamp. Nothing here is a probability invented by this session: quotes that fail the published spread/identity contract are recorded as guidance only and the pick stays blank. Hotspawn "% picked" and HLTV fan "Pick a winner" votes were seen on the source pages and are deliberately excluded from every calculation. The live collector re-validates all of this at each four-hour refresh; these are dated observations, not permanent prices.

limitations: Two fixtures (1079170, 1081515) are expected to resolve at the next refresh via evidence-backed scoped aliases and observed compliant books; until the collector replays them, the public pick rows remain blank — this session never hand-writes a probability into a pick file.

Four unreachable esportsbooks (GG.BET 403, Pinnacle redirects to a landing page, Rivalry redirects to a landing page, Stake 403) are documented source failures, not evidence that no market exists. EGamersWorld and similar tips sites publish equal 1.8/1.8 placeholder prices that carry no information and are rejected.

HLTV fan "Pick a winner" votes and Hotspawn "% picked" were visible during research and are excluded from every number on this site.

The BetBoom vs Legacy Group B decider was still in progress at the final observation of this window; the Day-4 semifinal pairing for Falcons is therefore recorded as "BetBoom/Legacy winner" rather than guessed.
All quotes in this dossier are dated observations from 2026-10-16; the four-hour publisher supersedes them with freshly replayed books. Nothing here is a guarantee or a betting recommendation.
